heading: Proof of documents by production of certified copies.
text: Such certified copies may be produced in proof of the contents of the public documents or parts of the public documents of which they purport to be copies.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
